title: Account Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Account Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Icon makes winning ads and branded content for some of the fastest-growing DTC and enterprise companies in the world. We're now launching our managed creative/ads services and looking to scale our team aggressively. We're on a mission to become a trillion dollar generational company. Overview We're hiring an Account Manager to own our client relationships end-to-end. You'll be the face of Icon to the brands we work with — making sure they're getting results, renewing, and expanding, while keeping our creative team pointed at the highest-impact work every single day. You'll be part relationship-builder, part strategist — we'll rely on you to keep clients happy, informed, and growing their spend with us. At the same time, you'll be the connective tissue between the client and our creative pipeline — as an agency producing tens of thousands of ads per month, you'll make sure every client's goals translate cleanly into briefs, deliverables, and performance. You are the person who makes sure clients stay, win, and scale with Icon. What You'll Own 1) Client Relationships & Retention (Trust + Renewals) Own the day-to-day relationship: you're the primary point of contact and the person clients trust. Run regular check-ins, updates, and reviews so clients always know where things stand. Set clear expectations and manage them proactively (no surprises, no silence). Catch dissatisfaction and churn risk early — and drive the save before it's a cancellation. Hit renewal and retention targets across your book of business. 2) Account Growth (Expansion + Spend) Identify upsell and expansion opportunities (more creators, more ad volume, new product lines). Build the case for growth with performance data and clear ROI. Coordinate with sales/leadership to close expansions and renewals. Grow each account's spend over time by proving Icon's value continuously. Turn happy clients into references, case studies, and referrals. 3) Execution & Cross-functional Coordination (Briefs + Performance) Translate client goals into clear, actionable briefs for the creative team. Coordinate priorities with Creative Ops so client work ships on time and at quality. Track and report on creative performance (delivery, throughput, results) back to clients. Own escalations: when something slips, you drive the fix across teams. Work closely with Ops and Engineering to remove recurring friction in the client workflow. You're a Fit If You... Have experience in account management / client success / agency relationship management (especially high-volume or performance-driven environments). Can build trust fast and manage clients with both warmth and high standards. Are commercially sharp: you spot growth opportunities and know how to close them. Are obsessive about follow-through, communication, and never letting a client feel ignored. Can translate messy client needs into clear requirements for the creative and eng teams.

title: Head Of Liquidity Latam
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head Of Liquidity Latam em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Company We are a leading digital asset platform that provides trading, brokerage, custody, and infrastructure solutions for institutional and professional investors. As the business continues to grow, they are seeking an experienced liquidity professional to lead and enhance their global liquidity capabilities. Role Overview This leadership role is responsible for overseeing liquidity strategy across digital asset and FX markets in LATAM, ensuring efficient market access, strong execution quality, and robust liquidity coverage across trading products. The successful candidate will work closely with Trading, Sales, Product, Risk, Compliance, Treasury, and Technology teams to support the firm's institutional trading business. We cover stablecoins, on/off ramp and cross-border payments as well. Candidates with relevant experiences will be prioritized. Key Responsibilities Liquidity Management Develop and execute the firm's liquidity strategy across digital asset and FX-related markets. Source, onboard, and manage relationships with liquidity providers, market makers, brokers, exchanges, and banking partners. Monitor liquidity quality, market depth, pricing competitiveness, and venue performance. Ensure sufficient liquidity coverage across supported products and trading activities. FX & Trading Operations Oversee liquidity and execution across FX and digital asset trading flows. Monitor market developments and identify opportunities to improve execution performance and pricing. Analyze trading activity, transaction costs, spreads, and execution metrics. Partner with trading and treasury teams to optimize execution workflows and market access. Counterparty & Vendor Management Build and maintain relationships with key liquidity providers and institutional counterparties. Support commercial negotiations, fee discussions, and service-level reviews. Conduct ongoing assessments and due diligence of trading venues and liquidity partners. Risk & Governance Work closely with Risk and Compliance teams to ensure appropriate controls and oversight. Monitor counterparty, settlement, and liquidity-related risks. Support contingency planning and business continuity measures during periods of market stress. Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement Lead and develop the liquidity function. Collaborate with internal stakeholders across Trading, Treasury, Product, Technology, Risk, and Compliance teams. Provide management reporting on liquidity performance, market developments, and strategic initiatives. Requirements Significant experience in liquidity management, electronic trading, FX trading, market structure, market making, brokerage, or institutional trading environments. Experience sourcing, evaluating, and managing relationships with liquidity providers, brokers, market makers, exchanges, and banking partners. Strong understanding of FX and/or digital asset liquidity ecosystems and execution practices. Ability to analyze execution quality, transaction costs, and liquidity performance metrics. Commercially minded with strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills. Experience working within regulated financial services environments. Excellent communication, leadership, and relationship management capabilities.

title: Direct-Response Ad Video Editor
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Direct-Response Ad Video Editor em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We're looking for a direct response video editor who can produce 1-3 performance ads per day — consistently, quickly, and without hand-holding. You'll receive reference ads, raw footage, AI-generated visuals, voiceover audio, product photography, UGC clips, and creative briefs. Your job is to turn those inputs into scroll-stopping Meta ads that look native to the feed, follow direct response principles, and are ready to launch same-day. Some days you'll get a detailed brief with every asset handed to you. Other days you'll get a reference ad and a direction — and you'll need to reverse-engineer the structure, build a visual concept, and deliver a finished ad using your own creative instincts. This is not a 9-to-5 editing job. This is a performance marketing role that happens to live inside an editing timeline. What You'll Be Doing Editing 1-3 short-form video ads per day (15-60 seconds) for Meta placements Working with a mix of UGC footage, AI-generated imagery, 3D medical-style animations, product photography, voiceover tracks, and b-roll Receiving reference ads and reverse-engineering their pacing, structure, visual rhythm, and caption systems to build VelorHealth versions Building ads from creative briefs that include scripts, shot lists, visual direction, and caption specs Originating new ad concepts when given only a direction or angle — proposing visual treatments, caption styles, and pacing without being told exactly what to do Implementing caption systems with color-coded text (white/red/blue pill captions, green keyword highlights, auto-generated TikTok-style captions) depending on the ad format Cutting multiple versions of the same ad (hook variants, length variants, aspect ratio variants) for A/B testing Maintaining a fast turnaround — most ads should go from brief to finished export within 2-4 hours Organizing and managing a growing library of raw assets, finished ads, and creative templates What You Need Proven experience editing direct response or performance marketing video ads (not brand content, not music videos, not wedding films — direct response ads that ran on Meta or TikTok with measurable results) Fluency in CapCut, Premiere Pro, or After Effects — whichever you're fastest in Strong understanding of Meta ad formats — you know what a native feed ad looks like versus a produced commercial, and you default to native Ability to match reference ad pacing intuitively — if we send you a competitor ad, you can deconstruct its cut timing, caption rhythm, and visual structure without being taught Comfort working with AI-generated imagery and integrating it seamlessly into live footage and product photography Experience with caption styling — you've built caption systems before (color-coded, keyword-highlighted, timed to VO) and you understand that captions are a conversion tool, not an accessibility afterthought A sharp eye for thumbnail-level scroll-stopping — you understand that the first frame of a video ad is a static image in the feed and you treat it accordingly Ability to self-manage, meet daily output targets, and communicate proactively when something is unclear or delayed Reliable internet connection and availability during US business hours (ET or CT preferred but flexible for the right person) Bonus (Not Required) Experience editing ads in the health, wellness, fitness, or DTC supplement space Familiarity with the "ugly ad" aesthetic — ads intentionally designed to look like organic UGC rather than polished production Experience with motion graphics or basic After Effects animation (for text overlays, simple transitions, or kinetic typography) Understanding of direct response copywriting principles (you know why a hook matters, why the product should appear early, why the CTA needs to sound like a peer recommendation) What You Don't Need A film degree A fancy reel of cinematic work Experience at a big agency Color grading expertise We care about speed, instinct, and output quality at volume. If your best work is a single beautifully-graded 3-minute brand film, this isn't the right fit. If your best work is 47 Meta ads you cut last month that all drove profitable ROAS, we want to talk to you. Compensation Competitive rate based on experience. This is a contract role with potential to grow into a long-term position as the brand scales. We value speed and consistency — editors who hit daily output targets reliably will have no shortage of work. How To Apply There will be a paid test before any hire is made. Here's how it works: Apply with your portfolio. Send 3-5 examples of direct response video ads you've edited that actually ran on Meta or TikTok. Tell us the niche, the objective, and the result if you have it. We don't need a sizzle reel — we need proof you've done this before. If your portfolio fits, we'll send you a paid test project. You'll receive a reference ad, a script, raw assets (footage, images, voiceover), and a creative brief. You'll have 24 hours to deliver a finished ad. This test is paid regardless of whether you're hired. We evaluate the test on four criteria: Did you match the pacing and structure of the reference? Did the first frame stop the scroll? Did the captions and visual rhythm support the VO? Did you deliver on time? If the test passes, you start with a one-week trial at 1 ad per day. If that week goes well, we scale to full output. We're not looking for perfection. We're looking for someone who ships fast, learns from references quickly, and gets better with every ad they cut. To apply, send your portfolio and a brief note about your direct response editing experience to (your email) with the subject line "DR Editor — (Your Name)."

title: Qc Analyst - Audio Content - Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Qc Analyst - Audio Content - Brazil em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us Pocket FM is the world's largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens. At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact. Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide. Role Overview As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives. Key Responsibilities 1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files) Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script. Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards. Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval. 2. Script-to-Audio Alignment Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression. Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration. 3. Technical & Creative Accuracy Check audio for: Voice clarity and consistency Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness Background noise or distortions Timing and pacing issues Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files Grammatically incorrect words/sentences Physical noise of voice artist Abrupt cut / jerk Sibilance Fumble / mumble 4. Vendor & Artist Coordination Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback. Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions. 5. QC Documentation & Tracking Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level. Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content). Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines. 6. Pre-Release Quality Checks Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform. Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards. 7. Cross-Team Collaboration Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality. Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows. 8. Process Improvement Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies. Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows. Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology 9. Volume & Deadline Management Handle QC for approximately 80 hours of audio content within defined timelines. Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content. 10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to: Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible. Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements. Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field. Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics. Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred. Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus. Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content. Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment. Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork. Language requirements Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in English This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis. Salary for this position is R$ $3800 - $4100 BRL.

title: Operations Manager (Product)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Operations Manager (Product) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About Revolut People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day. As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to WorkTM. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution. About the role At Revolut, Operations means problem-solving at scale. Our team tackles the company's toughest challenges with speed, precision, and creativity. They design systems that unlock efficiency and power global growth. We're looking for a Product Operations Manager to help shape how we continue to expand and operate across the globe. You'll work on high-impact initiatives throughout the business, using insight to solve challenges, scale processes, and deliver better outcomes for our customers. Watch this video from our team members about what goes into being a Strategy & Operations Manager at Revolut. Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch. What you'll be doing Developing a point of view on specific fintech verticals and defining a cohesive long-term strategy for the company and product departments Acting as the eyes and ears of the company, feeding information from the market back into company strategy and department roadmaps Tracking and analysing competitive position and product performance globally Helping scope and launch new verticals for the company Defining initial product proposition and go-to-market strategies for new expansion markets What you'll need At least a 2:1 degree from a top university A STEM or other highly quantitative degree from a top-tier university A track record of outstanding achievement in different areas 3+ years of experience in a strategy consulting, investment banking/PE/VC, or fast-growing technology company in a product or strategy role Great problem-solving skills A focus on customer-centric designs and solutions Nice to have A track record of building successful products (ideally financial) using data, customer feedback, common sense, and/or machine learning Compensation range Krakow: PLN19,500 - PLN21,600 gross monthly* Poland: PLN19,500 - PLN21,600 gross monthly* Other locations: Compensation will be discussed during the interview process *Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate's qualifications, skills, and previous experience Building a global financial super app isn't enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that's why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We're doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That's why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team. Important notice for candidates: Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.
- Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don't use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.
- Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.Com domain. We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it's a scam. Report it immediately. By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. title: Global Ta Manager (Contractor Role)
description:

Location: Remote (Based in Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam, or Brazil) Contract Duration: 6 months (with potential for extension/long-term partnership) Compensation: Base Rate + Performance-Based Placement Bonus (Earn extra for every successful hire!) Role Overview We are stripping away the corporate red tape. This role is built for one thing and one thing only: Pure, High-Velocity Recruitment Delivery. As a Global TA Manager, you will focus entirely on the frontlines of our international experienced hiring tracks (spanning R&D, Product, and Growth) across the U.S., Europe, LATAM, and Asia. You will be the bridging force between global talent and our HQ team. If you are an independent recruiter who prides yourself on speed, market-mapping accuracy, and closing deals, this is your playground. What You Will Do- High-Volume Sourcing & Delivery: Own the end-to-end sourcing and pipeline management for mid-to-senior global roles. You will hunt via LinkedIn, regional job boards, GitHub, and cold-outreach to keep our pipelines buzzing. HQ & Candidate Facilitation: Screen global talent, pitch our vision, and seamlessly manage candidates through the interview process, acting as the primary point of contact. Data & Pipeline Transparency: Keep candidate trackers clean and updated, ensuring our global talent pipelines are accurate and moving fast. The DNA We Are Looking For- The Baseline (Hard Skills): Bilingual Mastery (English & Chinese): Both English and Mandarin Chinese must be your fluent working languages. You can interview global talent in flawless English and align instantly with our HQ hiring managers in Chinese. Proven Recruitment Engine: 2-4+ years of recruiting experience in tech, internet, or global expansion enterprises. A proven track record of delivering cross-border talent is a massive plus. Geographic Flexibility: Based in Indonesia, Vietnam, or the U.S., with deep roots in local talent networks but a completely global mindset. Core Traits (Soft Skills): The "Bias for Action" Delivery Machine: You are fiercely result-oriented, self-driven, and hyper-focused on closing roles. You think on your feet and get things done without waiting for instructions. Insatiable Curiosity & No Guardrails: You don't get trapped by fixed processes. You are eager to experiment with new sourcing hacks, leverage AI tools, and test bold outreach strategies to find that needle in a haystack. What You Will Get & The Challenges You Will Face What You Will Get: Uncapped Earning Potential: On top of your base rate, we offer a highly competitive, milestone-based placement bonus layout. The faster and more effectively you deliver, the more you earn. The Global Flex-Work Playbook: Get hands-on, practical experience inside a highly progressive global flexible-staffing ecosystem. You'll see exactly how a top-tier global tech brand runs an agile, remote talent network. A Trusted Extension of the Crew: No micromanagement. You enjoy the ultimate flexibility of a remote setup while having a world-class global TA team supporting you from behind. The Challenges You Will Face: 100% Remote Coordination: Working across time zones requires you to be hyper-proactive. You must be comfortable with asynchronous communication and managing your own energy and schedule. Embracing Ambiguity: Global talent markets move fast and change constantly. You need to be comfortable adjusting your sourcing strategy on the fly when a business need shifts. If you are a bilingual recruitment hustler who is ready to deliver global talent and write your own paycheck via performance bonuses, let's talk. Apply now and let's make a global impact together!

Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade. O diferencial? Aqui você é mais que um professor. Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos. Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora. Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas. Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar. Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos! O que eu faço? QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO? Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos. Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores. Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Business Analyst
description:

We give leaders the data they need to create awe-inspiring safety cultures that ignite their team's potential. Engaged teams are the beating heart of industry-leading, odds-defying workplaces, and we're committed to helping clients achieve that. Our mission is simple: create engaged cultures and healthier environments for all. Who are we? Key Responsibilities Lead customer workshops and meetings to capture, validate, and finalise business requirements in line with scope. Translate customer needs into clear, technically aligned documentation using tools such as process flows, user stories, and functional specifications. Collaborate with internal teams (Project Managers, Implementation Specialists) to ensure smooth solution delivery. Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by validating builds against requirements and assisting with defect triage. Contribute to a smooth customer transition from implementation to business-as-usual (BAU) through handover documentation. Maintain a deep understanding of ecoPortal's platform functionality to provide practical, value-driven guidance. Assist with continuous improvement initiatives, helping to refine our BA tools, templates, and methodologies. We're Looking for Someone Who... Has 2+ years of Business Analyst experience, ideally within SaaS or software implementation environments. Demonstrates strong requirement gathering, analysis, and solution design capabilities. Can confidently facilitate workshops and work directly with customers and internal teams to define the "what" and the "why." Is proficient in documentation practices, including process mapping, user stories, functional specs, and change logs. Understands the value of collaboration and can work fluidly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Has exposure to project delivery methodologies such as Agile or Hybrid models. Communicates clearly and confidently, both verbally and in writing. Is naturally curious and detail-oriented, with a drive to understand how things work and improve them. Has experience or familiarity with Health, Safety, Risk, and Compliance (HSRC) systems – a bonus, but not required! Holds relevant certifications in Business Analysis (e.G., CBAP, CCBA ) or has equivalent experience – highly desirable. Perks & Benefits: 37-Hour Work Week & Flexible Working: We prioritise work-life balance by offering a 37-hour workweek and flexible working arrangements. Some of your working hours will be aligned with the New Zealand time zone to ensure collaboration with the team. Generous Annual Leave Birthday Perk: You get to take your birthday off! If it falls on a weekend, you can choose a day close to your birthday to celebrate. Milestone Birthdays are celebrated extra special with ecoPortal. End-of-Year Celebration: Enter the draw for a chance to join the team at ecoPortal HQ in New Zealand for our epic end-of-year celebrations! The longer you've been with eP, the more entries you get. We've got flights, accommodation, and meals all covered while you're here. ️ Professional Development: ecoPortal offer financial assistance for Business English Language Courses, apps, or training. Wellness Support: To support your mental health and overall wellbeing, we offer reimbursements for professional mental health assistance. Workplace Enjoyment: We believe in fostering a positive, engaged, and diverse team through various social activities. Enjoy virtual social events and company-wide activations with the ecoPortal HQ team in NZ and our global offshore team. What now? Ready to introduce yourself? Don't be shy! We want to hear from you. Please upload your resume, cover letter, and any other information, documents and links that will help you stand out. Find out more about ecoPortal visit. ecoPortal is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Senior Revops Analyst - Churn
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Revops Analyst - Churn em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Contract Type: Fixed-Term Contract (Maternity Leave Cover) Duration: 6 months initially, with potential extension to 9 months. About the Role We are seeking a Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn to join our Customer organisation. Reporting to the RevOps Senior Manager - Customer, this role will lead the reporting, analysis, and process evolution of churn performance as the business scales across multiple business units. This is a highly visible analytical role responsible for ensuring customer churn, revenue impact, retention activity, and related operational metrics are reported accurately, consistently, and with clear business insight. You will partner closely with Renewals, Customer Success, Finance, RevOps, and senior leadership to turn churn data into actionable commentary and decisions. The role will strengthen Salesforce and related reporting processes as reliable systems of record, while continuously improving the cadence, quality, and efficiency of churn reporting across the organisation. Key Responsibilities Churn Reporting & Revenue Impact Own reporting of customer churn and associated revenue impact across all business units. Ensure accuracy across multiple methodologies, reconcile results where required, and translate the numbers into a clear story that can be understood and acted on by senior leaders. Retention Analysis & Insight Analyse the customer(churn pipeline and build reporting that delivers insight into retention initiatives, discount usage, save rates, customer contact rates, customer health status, and other leading or lagging indicators of churn risk. Process Standardisation & Continuous Improvement Drive standardisation and evolution of churn reporting processes as systems, definitions, and business processes mature. Proactively identify opportunities to improve the reporting cycle, increase efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance the quality of insight month over month. Salesforce Data Quality & Governance Strengthen Salesforce as a system of record by validating data, identifying reporting exceptions, and partnering with Renewals, RevOps, Finance, and Revenue Technology stakeholders to ensure dashboards are accurate and items that are not true churn are not reported as churn. Monthly Business Review Preparation & Presentation Prepare materials, briefing documents, and commentary for monthly business reviews. Deep dive into reported numbers, explain key movements and drivers, present insights to senior leaders including the CFO and CCO, respond to queries, track actions, and evolve the reporting process. Required Qualifications & Experience Technical & Operational Expertise Strong experience in an analytical, finance, revenue operations, customer operations, or similar data-driven role. Bachelor's degree minimum, ideally in Economics, Finance, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field. Strong working knowledge of Salesforce, particularly opportunity management, renewal and churn data, reporting structures, and data flows that impact customer and revenue reporting. High proficiency in Excel, with the ability to manage complex calculations, reconcile datasets, investigate variances, and build structured reporting outputs. Experience with BI or reporting tools such as Power BI is advantageous. Revenue & Churn Acumen Experience working with finance and revenue data, including the concepts of annual recurring revenue (ARR) and contracted annual recurring revenue (CARR) in a subscription or SaaS business. Ability to connect churn revenue metrics to retention activity, customer health indicators, and operational performance metrics. Strong analytical judgement, with the ability to double click into results, identify root causes, and explain whether movements are driven by data quality, process, customer behaviour, commercial actions, or broader business trends. Understanding of customer lifecycle, renewals, retention, and churn management processes is highly desirable. Leadership & Stakeholder Management Competent and confident presenting to, influencing, and constructively challenging senior stakeholders. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working across multiple stakeholders in a global organisation. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to turn complex data into clear insight, concise commentary, and practical recommendations. Proactive, curious, and comfortable operating in an evolving environment where processes, systems, and definitions continue to mature. Why This Role Matters Customer health and recurring revenue are central to a growth business. This role ensures the organisation has accurate, consistent, and insightful visibility of churn and retention performance, helping leaders identify early warning signals, understand the impact of retention initiatives, and take action to protect material revenue. As the company scales, the Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn will play a key role in strengthening the reporting foundation, improving Salesforce data quality, and enabling better decisions that support customer satisfaction, renewal outcomes, and sustainable growth.

title: Fx Trader
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Fx Trader em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties. Key Responsibilities FX Trading & Liquidity Management Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on African (e.G., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.G., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets. Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions. Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure. Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets. Hedging Strategy & Risk Management Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures. Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant. Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization. Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books. Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including: Automated hedging engines Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols. Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring. Market Development Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows. Requirements Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets. Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies, such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades. Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets NDF markets and offshore hedging Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems Hedging engines Liquidity aggregation platforms Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution. Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments. Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks. Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations. Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources. Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies. Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations. Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Business Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Analyst em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Our purpose ecoPortal health and safety engagement software helps organisations amplify workplace safety. We give leaders the data they need to create awe-inspiring safety cultures that ignite their team's potential. Engaged teams are the beating heart of industry-leading, odds-defying workplaces, and we're committed to helping clients achieve that. Our mission is simple: create engaged cultures and healthier environments for all. Who are we? We're a true Kiwi tech success story, built from the ground up, with a vision of transforming the health and safety industry as we know it. We're anchored by our commitment to championing people. That commitment begins from within—with our very own team. Our team culture is an organic creation built by our people, for our people. Differences are celebrated here, and we firmly believe that our diverse lived experiences work together to make us stronger as a whole. You can see more about our storyjourney here! We create intuitive health and safety software that people want to use, giving businesses the visibility and data they need to prevent risks and build stronger, safer workplaces and safety cultures. Safety isn't just a department, it's a culture that involves everyone, from frontline workers to the boardroom. ecoPortal makes safety simple, visible, and shared, with an intuitive interface that people actually want to use. We help create stronger engagement, fewer incidents, and measurable improvements that drive both culture and performance. The Role An exciting opportunity is available at ecoPortal. We are looking for a Business Analyst to join our Project Management Office (PMO) Team, supporting the successful implementation of our Health, Safety, Risk, and Compliance SaaS platform. You'll play a vital role in gathering, analysing, and finalising customer requirements, ensuring that each solution is tailored to deliver value while aligning with ecoPortal's product capabilities and delivery standards. As a Business Analyst, you'll collaborate closely with Project Managers, Implementation Specialists, and customer stakeholders to design fit-for-purpose solutions—ranging from minimal changes to standard templates through to complex, bespoke configurations. You'll need strong communication, analytical, and documentation skills, and an ability to work across technical and business teams to ensure clarity, alignment, and successful delivery. Key Responsibilities Lead customer workshops and meetings to capture, validate, and finalise business requirements in line with scope. Translate customer needs into clear, technically aligned documentation using tools such as process flows, user stories, and functional specifications. Support the design of both standard and custom solutions that align with ecoPortal platform capabilities. Collaborate with internal teams (Project Managers, Implementation Specialists) to ensure smooth solution delivery. Proactively identify and flag risks or misalignments early, recommending alternative solutions where appropriate. Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by validating builds against requirements and assisting with defect triage. Contribute to a smooth customer transition from implementation to business-as-usual (BAU) through handover documentation. Maintain a deep understanding of ecoPortal's platform functionality to provide practical, value-driven guidance. Assist with continuous improvement initiatives, helping to refine our BA tools, templates, and methodologies. We're Looking for Someone Who... Has 2+ years of Business Analyst experience, ideally within SaaS or software implementation environments. Demonstrates strong requirement gathering, analysis, and solution design capabilities. Can confidently facilitate workshops and work directly with customers and internal teams to define the "what" and the "why." Is proficient in documentation practices, including process mapping, user stories, functional specs, and change logs. Understands the value of collaboration and can work fluidly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Has exposure to project delivery methodologies such as Agile or Hybrid models. Communicates clearly and confidently, both verbally and in writing. Is naturally curious and detail-oriented, with a drive to understand how things work and improve them. Has experience or familiarity with Health, Safety, Risk, and Compliance (HSRC) systems – a bonus, but not required! Holds relevant certifications in Business Analysis (e.G., CBAP, CCBA ) or has equivalent experience – highly desirable. Perks & Benefits: 37-Hour Work Week & Flexible Working: We prioritise work-life balance by offering a 37-hour workweek and flexible working arrangements. Some of your working hours will be aligned with the New Zealand time zone to ensure collaboration with the team. Generous Annual Leave Birthday Perk: You get to take your birthday off! If it falls on a weekend, you can choose a day close to your birthday to celebrate. Milestone Birthdays are celebrated extra special with ecoPortal. End-of-Year Celebration: Enter the draw for a chance to join the team at ecoPortal HQ in New Zealand for our epic end-of-year celebrations! The longer you've been with eP, the more entries you get. We've got flights, accommodation, and meals all covered while you're here. ️ Professional Development: ecoPortal offer financial assistance for Business English Language Courses, apps, or training. Wellness Support: To support your mental health and overall wellbeing, we offer reimbursements for professional mental health assistance. Workplace Enjoyment: We believe in fostering a positive, engaged, and diverse team through various social activities. Enjoy virtual social events and company-wide activations with the ecoPortal HQ team in NZ and our global offshore team. What now? Ready to introduce yourself? Don't be shy! We want to hear from you. Please upload your resume, cover letter, and any other information, documents and links that will help you stand out. Find out more about ecoPortal visit. ecoPortal is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Project Manager 1008790
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Project Manager 1008790 em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants. Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade. O que esperar de nós Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco? Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade. Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento. Nosso Cliente Estamos em busca de um profissional em projetos de TI que deverá impulsionar a excelência na execução dos projetos, manter o controle sobre escopo, cronograma e orçamento, além de assegurar entregas de alta qualidade em todas as frentes. Esta função será responsável por supervisionar a entrega ponta a ponta de quatro novos mód ulos voltados ao suporte das capacidades de Compras (Procurement), garantindo o alinhamento entre as áreas de negócio, equipes de TI e uma organização terceirizada de desenvolvimento. O candidato selecionado fará parte de um projeto global em uma empresa multinacional do setor de eletrodomést i cos. O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho: Gestão do Programa e Supervisão das Entregas (Program & Delivery Oversight) Será responsável pela entrega geral do roadmap dos módulos do Supplier Portal (4 subprojetos), gerenciando cronograma, orçamento, escopo e acompanhamento de marcos (milestones) em nível de programa. Também deverá manter controle rigoroso sobre a definição de escopo, gestão de mudanças e dependências entre projetos e sistemas, além de supervisionar o desempenho do Delivery Manager e da equipe terceirizada para garantir o cumprimento dos compromissos. Governança e Comitês Executivos (Governance & Steering) Será responsável por definir e conduzir a estrutura de governança do projeto, liderando reuniões de Comitê Executivo (SteerCo), incluindo reporte de status, gestão de riscos e escalonamentos, além dos fóruns de tomada de decisão. Também deverá fornecer visibilidade e relatórios em nível executivo, assegurando transparência sobre o andamento do programa. Gestão de Stakeholders e Alinhamento com o Negócio (Stakeholder & Business Alignment) Será responsável pelo relacionamento com stakeholders da área de Compras (Procurement) e com a liderança sênior, garantindo que os requisitos de negócio sejam claramente definidos, aprovados e priorizados. Deverá promover o alinhamento entre a área de Negócios (Procurement), as equipes de TI (MDR, PLM e Integração) e a organização responsável pela entrega, atuando ainda como ponto final de escalonamento para conflitos ou ambiguidades relacionadas ao negócio. Gestão de Riscos e Problemas (Risk & Issue Management) Deverá identificar proativamente riscos e dependências em nível de programa, garantindo que sejam mitigados de forma antecipada e sistemática. Também será responsável por escalar questões críticas com recomendações claras e análise de impacto. Controle Financeiro e Planejamento (Financial & Planning Control) Será responsável pelo acompanhamento e previsão orçamentária, garantindo que as entregas permaneçam dentro dos limites financeiros aprovados. Também deverá validar a alocação de recursos em conjunto com o Delivery Manager. Liderança e Direcionamento (Leadership & Direction) Deverá fornecer direcionamento claro e definição de prioridades ao Delivery Manager, garantindo foco em resultados, cumprimento de prazos e geração de valor para o negócio. Espera-se uma atuação proativa na resolução de ambiguidades e na remoção de impedimentos para acelerar a tomada de decisões e o progresso do programa. O que você precisa ter: Inglê s - Avançado (necessário para Experiência como Gerente de Projetos de TI em ambientes complexos e com múltiplas frentes de trabalho simultâneas. Experiência com metodologias ágeis de entrega (Agile). Capacidade de gerenciar equipes de desenvolvimento terceirizadas. Excelentes habilidades de gestão de stakeholders e comunicação. Forte capacidade de organização e definição de prioridades. Habilidade para atuar como ponte entre as necessidades do negócio e a entrega técnica. Perfil altamente proativo e orientado à solução de problemas. Elevada atenção aos detalhes, mantendo ao mesmo tempo uma visão estratégica e abrangente do projeto. Identificar e mitigar riscos de forma antecipada, reduzindo impactos ao programa. Entregar soluções escaláveis e de alta qualidade, alinhadas à estratégia da plataforma Supplier Portal. Modelo de atuação: No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office!

title: Direct-Response Ad Video Editor
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Direct-Response Ad Video Editor em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We're looking for a direct response video editor who can produce 1-3 performance ads per day — consistently, quickly, and without hand-holding. You'll receive reference ads, raw footage, AI-generated visuals, voiceover audio, product photography, UGC clips, and creative briefs. Your job is to turn those inputs into scroll-stopping Meta ads that look native to the feed, follow direct response principles, and are ready to launch same-day. Some days you'll get a detailed brief with every asset handed to you. Other days you'll get a reference ad and a direction — and you'll need to reverse-engineer the structure, build a visual concept, and deliver a finished ad using your own creative instincts. This is not a 9-to-5 editing job. This is a performance marketing role that happens to live inside an editing timeline. What You'll Be Doing Editing 1-3 short-form video ads per day (15-60 seconds) for Meta placements Working with a mix of UGC footage, AI-generated imagery, 3D medical-style animations, product photography, voiceover tracks, and b-roll Receiving reference ads and reverse-engineering their pacing, structure, visual rhythm, and caption systems to build VelorHealth versions Building ads from creative briefs that include scripts, shot lists, visual direction, and caption specs Originating new ad concepts when given only a direction or angle — proposing visual treatments, caption styles, and pacing without being told exactly what to do Implementing caption systems with color-coded text (white/red/blue pill captions, green keyword highlights, auto-generated TikTok-style captions) depending on the ad format Cutting multiple versions of the same ad (hook variants, length variants, aspect ratio variants) for A/B testing Maintaining a fast turnaround — most ads should go from brief to finished export within 2-4 hours Organizing and managing a growing library of raw assets, finished ads, and creative templates What You Need Proven experience editing direct response or performance marketing video ads (not brand content, not music videos, not wedding films — direct response ads that ran on Meta or TikTok with measurable results) Fluency in CapCut, Premiere Pro, or After Effects — whichever you're fastest in Strong understanding of Meta ad formats — you know what a native feed ad looks like versus a produced commercial, and you default to native Ability to match reference ad pacing intuitively — if we send you a competitor ad, you can deconstruct its cut timing, caption rhythm, and visual structure without being taught Comfort working with AI-generated imagery and integrating it seamlessly into live footage and product photography Experience with caption styling — you've built caption systems before (color-coded, keyword-highlighted, timed to VO) and you understand that captions are a conversion tool, not an accessibility afterthought A sharp eye for thumbnail-level scroll-stopping — you understand that the first frame of a video ad is a static image in the feed and you treat it accordingly Ability to self-manage, meet daily output targets, and communicate proactively when something is unclear or delayed Reliable internet connection and availability during US business hours (ET or CT preferred but flexible for the right person) Bonus (Not Required) Experience editing ads in the health, wellness, fitness, or DTC supplement space Familiarity with the "ugly ad" aesthetic — ads intentionally designed to look like organic UGC rather than polished production Experience with motion graphics or basic After Effects animation (for text overlays, simple transitions, or kinetic typography) Understanding of direct response copywriting principles (you know why a hook matters, why the product should appear early, why the CTA needs to sound like a peer recommendation) What You Don't Need A film degree A fancy reel of cinematic work Experience at a big agency Color grading expertise We care about speed, instinct, and output quality at volume. If your best work is a single beautifully-graded 3-minute brand film, this isn't the right fit. If your best work is 47 Meta ads you cut last month that all drove profitable ROAS, we want to talk to you. Compensation Competitive rate based on experience. This is a contract role with potential to grow into a long-term position as the brand scales. We value speed and consistency — editors who hit daily output targets reliably will have no shortage of work. How To Apply There will be a paid test before any hire is made. Here's how it works: Apply with your portfolio. Send 3-5 examples of direct response video ads you've edited that actually ran on Meta or TikTok. Tell us the niche, the objective, and the result if you have it. We don't need a sizzle reel — we need proof you've done this before. If your portfolio fits, we'll send you a paid test project. You'll receive a reference ad, a script, raw assets (footage, images, voiceover), and a creative brief. You'll have 24 hours to deliver a finished ad. This test is paid regardless of whether you're hired. We evaluate the test on four criteria: Did you match the pacing and structure of the reference? Did the first frame stop the scroll? Did the captions and visual rhythm support the VO? Did you deliver on time? If the test passes, you start with a one-week trial at 1 ad per day. If that week goes well, we scale to full output. We're not looking for perfection. We're looking for someone who ships fast, learns from references quickly, and gets better with every ad they cut. To apply, send your portfolio and a brief note about your direct response editing experience to (your email) with the subject line "DR Editor — (Your Name)."

title: Professor De Espanhol
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor De Espanhol em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil! Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares! A Idioma Independente, referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada. Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história. Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível. *Esta não é uma vaga CLT* O que oferecemos? Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente. Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil? Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você. Necessário: Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade. O diferencial? Aqui você é mais que um professor. Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos. Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora. Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas. Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar. Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos! O que eu faço? Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio. QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO? Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos. Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores. Seja diferente, seja independente

You will partner closely with customers, internal stakeholders, and product teams to ensure successful outcomes across architecture, deployment, scalability, and long-term value realization. You will influence architecture decisions for strategic customers and high-visibility engagements. IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL: Lead custom multi-node Linux installations and upgrades for Sisense deployments, including troubleshooting complex deployment issues. Own and troubleshoot multi-node Windows-to-Linux migration projects, backup and restore processes, and architecture-related escalations. Perform load testing, interpret results, and provide strategic recommendations for scaling, performance, and resource optimization. Analyze logs, system performance, and infrastructure telemetry to proactively identify risks and optimize customer environments. Partner with customer Application Developers, DevOps, IT teams, and executive sponsors to drive successful outcomes. Act as the voice of the customer by sharing product feedback, submitting bugs and feature requests, and influencing roadmap priorities. Lead enablement for internal teams, mentor Solution Architects, and support technical interviews for new hires. WHAT YOU'VE ACCOMPLISHED... SO FAR: 5+ years of related experience in customer-facing technical roles, with prior experience as a Solution Architect. Hands-on expertise with Linux (Ubuntu, Amazon Linux, RHEL/CentOS), Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, and cloud platforms such as AWS EKS / GKE. Strong experience troubleshooting distributed systems, networking, security, and system monitoring tools such as Grafana and Coralogix. Advanced working knowledge of MongoDB (or another NoSQL database), including query optimization and troubleshooting. Intermediate SQL skills with the ability to join data across disparate sources and optimize queries. Proficiency in scripting and coding with Bash, Python, JavaScript, and CSS. Experience with load testing tools such as K6 and with modern cloud data warehouse technologies (Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery) is a plus. Strong customer communication skills, with the ability to engage technical teams and executive stakeholders. HOW YOU'LL RAMP: By Day 30: Build a strong understanding of Sisense architecture, deployment models, product capabilities, and customer engagement processes. By Day 60: Independently lead standard and custom deployment activities, troubleshoot escalations, and support customer architecture reviews. By Day 90: Own complex technical engagements end-to-end, mentor junior team members, and contribute to internal best practices and enablement.

Confira esta oportunidade para Pessoa Analista De Remuneração E Dados Sr em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Nós, da Knewin, somos líderes na América Latina quando se trata de ajudar empresas e marcas a gerenciar sua reputação e presença online através de análises de dados. Com mais de 2.000 clientes, nosso objetivo é conectar nossos parceiros com seu público-alvo, visando conquistar sua preferência e alcançar resultados excepcionais para seus negócios. Valorizamos uma cultura que prioriza a agilidade, a flexibilidade e a satisfação do cliente, enquanto acreditamos no potencial transformador da tecnologia, do conhecimento e, principalmente, das pessoas. Estamos buscando uma Pessoa Analista de Remuneração e Dados SR para compor o time de Pessoas da Knewin. Nessa posição, você será responsável por garantir que nossa estrutura de remuneração seja competitiva, justa e sustentável — ao mesmo tempo em que transforma dados de RH em inteligência estratégica para o negócio. É uma vaga para quem une rigor analítico com visão de processos, e que se interessa genuinamente por automação e pelo uso prático de IA no dia a dia de RH. Se você gosta de trabalhar com dados, entende de remuneração e quer atuar em um ambiente onde tecnologia e pessoas caminham juntas, essa posição é para você! Responsabilidades e atribuições Estrutura de Cargos e Salários: Administrar e manter a estrutura de cargos e salários da organização, garantindo a atualização contínua de tabelas, faixas, políticas e critérios de movimentação interna;
Análises e Movimentações Salariais: Conduzir análises salariais para subsidiar decisões de promoções, enquadramentos e ajustes, propondo alternativas alinhadas às diretrizes de remuneração e ao orçamento da companhia;
Ciclos de Mérito e Calibração: Conduzir os ciclos anuais de mérito, promoções e calibração salarial, garantindo consistência, equidade e aderência às políticas internas;
Pesquisas Salariais e Inteligência de Mercado: Conduzir pesquisas de mercado e estudos comparativos, identificando oportunidades para melhorar a competitividade da remuneração e embasando propostas de revisão de política;
Descrições de Cargo: Manter e evoluir as descrições de cargo da organização, apoiando lideranças na definição clara de responsabilidades, requisitos e escopo das posições;
Remuneração Variável e Programas de Incentivo: Apoiar no desenho e revisão de políticas de Remuneração Variável (ICP, bônus, comissões) e programas de incentivo, contribuindo para a efetividade dos mecanismos de reconhecimento;
People Analytics e Dashboards: Desenvolver e manter indicadores de RH, estruturar bases de dados e construir dashboards gerenciais e executivos que transformem dados em insumos relevantes para a tomada de decisão;
Automação e IA aplicadaao RH: Apoiar na identificação, desenvolvimento e implementação de automações e soluções com Inteligência Artificial voltadas aos processos de RH, contribuindo para a evolução e escala da área;
Melhoria Contínua: Propor melhorias contínuas em práticas, políticas e processos de remuneração e gestão de dados, com visão sistêmica e foco em resultados. Requisitos e qualificações Formação superior completa em Administração, Economia, Estatística, Engenharia, Psicologia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;
Experiência consolidadaem Remuneração, Estrutura de Cargos e Salários e análises organizacionais;
Domínio avançado de Excel e/ou Google Sheets;
Experiência na construção de dashboards e indicadores em ferramentas de BI (Looker Studio ou similares);
Capacidade analítica para interpretar dados, identificar tendências e gerar insights para suporte à decisão. Também é legal se você tiver: Vivência com People Analytics e governança de dados de RH;
Experiência em empresasde tecnologia ou ambientes de startup;
Familiaridade com ferramentas de automação e aplicações práticas de Inteligência Artificial;
Experiência em modelos de trabalho remoto ou híbrido.

title: Emerging Market Trader
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Emerging Market Trader em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African/LATAM/Asian currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties. Key Responsibilities FX Trading & Liquidity Management Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on African (e.G., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS), LATAM (ARS, BRL, MXN) and/or Asian (IDR, VDN, etc.) on markets. Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions. Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure. Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets. Hedging Strategy & Risk Management Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures. Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant. Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization. Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books. Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including: Automated hedging engines Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols. Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring. Market Development Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows. Requirements Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets. Strong experience trading African currencies, such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades. Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets NDF markets and offshore hedging Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems Hedging engines Liquidity aggregation platforms Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution. Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments. Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks. Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations. Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources. Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies. Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations. Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

description:
