Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história. Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível. *Esta não é uma vaga CLT* O que oferecemos? Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente. Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil? Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você. Necessário: Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade. O diferencial? Aqui você é mais que um professor. Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos. Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora. Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas. Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar. Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos! O que eu faço? Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio. QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO? Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos. Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores. Seja diferente, seja independente

Help shape architecture decisions for a modern enterprise data platform built on Microsoft Fabric and Azure technologies. You'll work directly with senior leadership, influence architecture decisions, and help build a modern data foundation that will power business operations across multiple countries and brands.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Liquidity Partnership Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution. The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes. Key Responsibilities Business Development & Partnerships Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered) Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms) Market & Network Development Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa) Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape Execution & Collaboration Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships Banking & Infrastructure Setup Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement Requirements 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

Why Join the Solution Architect Team? Work at the intersection of customer success, cloud architecture, and data platforms. Help customers solve complex infrastructure, deployment, and performance challenges across our client's environments. Collaborate with Product, R&D, Support, and Customer Success teams to shape best practices and improve the platform. Influence architecture decisions for strategic customers and high-visibility engagements. In This Role, You Will Lead custom multi-node Linux installations and upgrades for our client's deployments, including troubleshooting complex deployment issues. Own and troubleshoot multi-node Windows-to-Linux migration projects, backup and restore processes, and architecture-related escalations. Analyze logs, system performance, and infrastructure telemetry to proactively identify risks and optimize customer environments. Partner with customer Application Developers, DevOps engineers, IT teams, and executive sponsors to drive successful outcomes. Act as the voice of the customer by sharing product feedback, submitting bugs and feature requests, and influencing roadmap priorities. Lead enablement initiatives for internal teams, mentor Solution Architects, and support technical interviews for new hires. What You've Accomplished So Far 5+ years of experience in customer-facing technical roles, including previous experience as a Solution Architect. Hands-on expertise with Linux (Ubuntu, Amazon Linux, RHEL/CentOS), Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, and cloud platforms such as AWS EKS and GKE. Strong experience troubleshooting distributed systems, networking, security, and monitoring tools such as Grafana and Coralogix. Advanced working knowledge of MongoDB or other NoSQL databases, including query optimization and troubleshooting. Intermediate SQL skills, with the ability to join data across disparate sources and optimize queries. Proficiency in scripting and programming using Bash, Python, JavaScript, and CSS. Experience with load-testing tools such as K6 and modern cloud data warehouse technologies (Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery) is a plus. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage both technical teams and executive stakeholders. How You'll Ramp Up By Day 30 Build a strong understanding of our client's architecture, deployment models, product capabilities, and customer engagement processes. By Day 60 Independently lead standard and custom deployment activities. Troubleshoot escalations and support customer architecture reviews. By Day 90 Own complex technical engagements end-to-end. Mentor junior team members.

title: Professor De Inglês
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor De Inglês em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil! Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares! A Idioma Independente, referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada. Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história. Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível. *Esta não é uma vaga CLT* O que oferecemos? Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente. Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil? Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você. Necessário: Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade. O diferencial? Aqui você é mais que um professor. Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos. Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora. Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas. Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar. Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos! O que eu faço? title: Data Entry Specialist
description:

Across more than 2.5 billion square feet of real estate and construction projects, Jones enables clients to leverage AI, software, and data to accelerate and strengthen insurance verification, collection, integration, and decision-making across commercial and residential asset classes. Please note that this is a dedicated, full-time position requiring your undivided professional focus;
it is not compatible with concurrent employment or part-time arrangements. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. We use focused assessments to evaluate fit. If you're detail-oriented and eager to grow, we encourage you to apply. What You'll Do Review Certificates of Insurance (COIs) and supporting documents, verifying that coverage meets each client's specific requirements;
Accurately input compliance data into our system and flag any gaps or missing coverage for resolution;
Follow internal processes and guidelines to ensure best practices are upheld;
Collaborate actively with the team to support shared goals and maintain workflow continuity. Who You Are A clear, professional communicator in English, with strong written and verbal skills for cross-team collaboration. Available 40 hours per week during U.S. business hours (EST). Consistently accurate, with a track record of meeting quality targets. Coachable and growth-minded: you respond well to feedback, document your learnings, and apply improvements quickly. Comfortable following structured workflows and confident enough to escalate when something doesn't add up. Self-motivated and persistent: you work well independently without needing close oversight. Background in insurance, data entry, quality assurance, or any structured, process-driven role is a plus. Why Join Jones Become an expert in an area of real estate/construction operations and insurance that is undergoing serious digital transformation Join an award-winning company tracking best-in-class SaaS growth month-over-month. Fair compensation with performance-based raises and bonuses;
Learn directly from talented, experienced leaders who are invested in your growth. Gain hands-on experience in a dynamic, multicultural startup environment. Be part of a lean, agile team with a strong culture and a big vision. Help Jones execute on a massive vision to build a network for risk & compliance transactions in the built world Develop a strong understanding of SaaS operations fundamentals and skills needed to grow in a start-up company. Our culture Our goal is to build a company where people feel ownership of their role and are able to grow and enrich their skills and experience. We also want to create an environment where people are challenged and encouraged to be entrepreneurial. We rely on our team to help identify and take action on initiatives that can move our business forward. Elements of our culture that can be seen in every one of our people are the following: Fall in love with problems – We are obsessed with solving customer problems because it's in our DNA — actively listening to customer challenges and treating them like our own. Give help generously – We hire and nurture brilliant people who are generous with their time, skills, and perspectives. This generosity compounds across the company. Own the outcome – Every day we make vital decisions that shape the future of our company. We hold ourselves accountable to these decisions in order to build a durable, powerful business. Take care of yourself – Building a category-leading company is hard. It can only be achieved by encouraging and enabling our team's mental, emotional, and physical well-being. Build trust everywhere – Every Jones experience is designed to give our clients, our team, and our industry unshakable confidence in the integrity of the company.

At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide. Role Overview As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives. Key Responsibilities 1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files) Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script. Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards. Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval. 2. Script-to-Audio Alignment Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression. Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration. 3. Technical & Creative Accuracy Check audio for: Voice clarity and consistency Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness Background noise or distortions Timing and pacing issues Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files Grammatically incorrect words/sentences Physical noise of voice artist Abrupt cut / jerk Sibilance Fumble / mumble 4. Vendor & Artist Coordination Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback. Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions. 5. QC Documentation & Tracking Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level. Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content). Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines. 6. Pre-Release Quality Checks Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform. Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards. 7. Cross-Team Collaboration Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality. Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows. 8. Process Improvement Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies. Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows. Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology 9. Volume & Deadline Management Handle QC for approximately 80 hours of audio content within defined timelines. Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content. 10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to: Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible. Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements. Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field. Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics. Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred. Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus. Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content. Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment. Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork. Language requirements Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in English This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis. Salary for this position is R$ $3800 - $4100 BRL.

title: Fx Trader
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Fx Trader em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties. Key Responsibilities FX Trading & Liquidity Management Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on African (e.G., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.G., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets. Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions. Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure. Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets. Hedging Strategy & Risk Management Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures. Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant. Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization. Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books. Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including: Automated hedging engines Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols. Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring. Market Development Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows. Requirements Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets. Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies, such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades. Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets NDF markets and offshore hedging Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems Hedging engines Liquidity aggregation platforms Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution. Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments. Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks. Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations. Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources. Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies. Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations. Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

Job Title: Senior User Researcher Location: Brazil (Remote) Employment Type: Contract We're looking for a driven and inspiring Senior User Researcher to join our global team, to help businesses shape their strategy and bring to life products that win people's hearts. You will have a chance to work across diverse industries and product lifecycles, partnering with some of the world's most recognisable brands. Bringing an experimental yet rigorous mindset, you will define the unknowns, challenge assumptions, and collaborate with stakeholders at every level to disrupt markets with new products or transform existing experiences, through customer-driven evidence. Responsibilities: Own user research stream on the project: from spotting opportunities through planning, user recruitment and execution, to helping the team prioritise and embed insight into the product. Set up and manage user research process throughout discovery and delivery of a project, ensuring it fits seamlessly within agile workflows. Conduct various types of research, depending on the context: exploratory, assessment, evaluative, quantitative and qualitative. Collaborate with the design and product team to action the insights and embed them into strategy, roadmap and solutions. Participate in enhancing the practice with the wider user research team: contribute to guidelines, knowledge sharings, supporting people who do research. Consult presale teams on user research approaches for potential new projects, if needed. Required skills and experience: Well-versed in core user research methods and able to execute them independently;
this is the minimum expectation for the role before we look at advanced skills. An experimental mindset combined with rigour: you are comfortable trying new tools and approaches, while knowing the true value of user research and guardrails. Proven experience assessing and validating early product concepts with various methods, not only interviews. Skilled in defining customer segmentation across various markets. Experience with recruiting participants for research. A star facilitator, known for leading workshops, design sprints, and co-creation sessions that spark creativity and build alignment. Strong sense of ownership and the drive to move work forward without waiting to be asked. You thrive on minimal direction: we'll support you, but we want you to be the one moving things forward. Stellar communication: advising, negotiating, and effectively collaborating with stakeholders at all levels. Able to connect the dots and create compelling, evidence-led narratives that impact the way stakeholders think, build empathy for customers and guide product decisions. Strong at managing priorities and deadlines: ready to stay organised and adaptable when things get busy or change direction. Well-versed in tools that streamline research: Maze, Dovetail or similar tools for synthesis, repositories, unmoderated testing etc. 5+ years of hands-on experience in a standalone user research role. Nice to have: Experience in Healthcare and/or Banking Data analytics experience Design experience Experience in pre-sale activities What's in it for you? The projects are various, which gives you a lot of new experiences and challenges. We work with start-ups, scale-ups and enterprise clients across different industries. Ability to experiment with new approaches in product that incorporate AI tools, where it is appropriate Work on projects for big global brands Exposure to different geographies Support and close collaboration with a cross-discipline team of Design, Product, BA and technical practitioners Competitive salary depending on your skills and experience. Constant development of your skills with the help of a knowledgeable product community: knowledge-sharing events and mentorship practices. Regular support of your research leader and mentor.

You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable. Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations. Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome. Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit. Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits. Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma. Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives. Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders. title: Liquidity Partnership Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Liquidity Partnership Manager em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution. The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes. Key Responsibilities Business Development & Partnerships Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered) Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms) Market & Network Development Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa) Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape Execution & Collaboration Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships Banking & Infrastructure Setup Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement Requirements 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties. Key Responsibilities FX Trading & Liquidity Management Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on African (e.G., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.G., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets. Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions. Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure. Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets. Hedging Strategy & Risk Management Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures. Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant. Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization. Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books. Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including: Automated hedging engines Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols. Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring. Market Development Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows. Requirements Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets. Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies, such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades. Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets NDF markets and offshore hedging Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems Hedging engines Liquidity aggregation platforms Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution. Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments. Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks. Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations. Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources. Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies. Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations. Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Senior Revops Analyst - Churn
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Revops Analyst - Churn em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Contract Type: Fixed-Term Contract (Maternity Leave Cover) Duration: 6 months initially, with potential extension to 9 months. About the Role We are seeking a Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn to join our Customer organisation. Reporting to the RevOps Senior Manager - Customer, this role will lead the reporting, analysis, and process evolution of churn performance as the business scales across multiple business units. This is a highly visible analytical role responsible for ensuring customer churn, revenue impact, retention activity, and related operational metrics are reported accurately, consistently, and with clear business insight. You will partner closely with Renewals, Customer Success, Finance, RevOps, and senior leadership to turn churn data into actionable commentary and decisions. The role will strengthen Salesforce and related reporting processes as reliable systems of record, while continuously improving the cadence, quality, and efficiency of churn reporting across the organisation. Key Responsibilities Churn Reporting & Revenue Impact Own reporting of customer churn and associated revenue impact across all business units. Ensure accuracy across multiple methodologies, reconcile results where required, and translate the numbers into a clear story that can be understood and acted on by senior leaders. Retention Analysis & Insight Analyse the customer(churn pipeline and build reporting that delivers insight into retention initiatives, discount usage, save rates, customer contact rates, customer health status, and other leading or lagging indicators of churn risk. Process Standardisation & Continuous Improvement Drive standardisation and evolution of churn reporting processes as systems, definitions, and business processes mature. Proactively identify opportunities to improve the reporting cycle, increase efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance the quality of insight month over month. Salesforce Data Quality & Governance Strengthen Salesforce as a system of record by validating data, identifying reporting exceptions, and partnering with Renewals, RevOps, Finance, and Revenue Technology stakeholders to ensure dashboards are accurate and items that are not true churn are not reported as churn. Monthly Business Review Preparation & Presentation Prepare materials, briefing documents, and commentary for monthly business reviews. Deep dive into reported numbers, explain key movements and drivers, present insights to senior leaders including the CFO and CCO, respond to queries, track actions, and evolve the reporting process. Required Qualifications & Experience Technical & Operational Expertise Strong experience in an analytical, finance, revenue operations, customer operations, or similar data-driven role. Bachelor's degree minimum, ideally in Economics, Finance, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field. Strong working knowledge of Salesforce, particularly opportunity management, renewal and churn data, reporting structures, and data flows that impact customer and revenue reporting. High proficiency in Excel, with the ability to manage complex calculations, reconcile datasets, investigate variances, and build structured reporting outputs. Experience with BI or reporting tools such as Power BI is advantageous. Revenue & Churn Acumen Experience working with finance and revenue data, including the concepts of annual recurring revenue (ARR) and contracted annual recurring revenue (CARR) in a subscription or SaaS business. Ability to connect churn revenue metrics to retention activity, customer health indicators, and operational performance metrics. Strong analytical judgement, with the ability to double click into results, identify root causes, and explain whether movements are driven by data quality, process, customer behaviour, commercial actions, or broader business trends. Understanding of customer lifecycle, renewals, retention, and churn management processes is highly desirable. Leadership & Stakeholder Management Competent and confident presenting to, influencing, and constructively challenging senior stakeholders. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working across multiple stakeholders in a global organisation. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to turn complex data into clear insight, concise commentary, and practical recommendations. Proactive, curious, and comfortable operating in an evolving environment where processes, systems, and definitions continue to mature. Why This Role Matters Customer health and recurring revenue are central to a growth business. This role ensures the organisation has accurate, consistent, and insightful visibility of churn and retention performance, helping leaders identify early warning signals, understand the impact of retention initiatives, and take action to protect material revenue. As the company scales, the Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn will play a key role in strengthening the reporting foundation, improving Salesforce data quality, and enabling better decisions that support customer satisfaction, renewal outcomes, and sustainable growth.

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lead Product Designer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Who are we? Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life. Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing. About the role This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs. You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here. Key responsibilities Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way. Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable. Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations. Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome. Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit. Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you. Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong. Must haves 6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly. Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs. Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency. Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits. Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma. Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives. Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders. Nice to have Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar). Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms. Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar). Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique. Working knowledge of HTML/CSS;
JavaScript a plus. Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience. Please submit your application with an English-language CV/resume and a portfolio showcasing relevant work samples.

title: Global Ta Manager (Contractor Role)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Global Ta Manager (Contractor Role) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Remote (Based in Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam, or Brazil) Contract Duration: 6 months (with potential for extension/long-term partnership) Compensation: Base Rate + Performance-Based Placement Bonus (Earn extra for every successful hire!) Role Overview We are stripping away the corporate red tape. This role is built for one thing and one thing only: Pure, High-Velocity Recruitment Delivery. As a Global TA Manager, you will focus entirely on the frontlines of our international experienced hiring tracks (spanning R&D, Product, and Growth) across the U.S., Europe, LATAM, and Asia. You will be the bridging force between global talent and our HQ team. If you are an independent recruiter who prides yourself on speed, market-mapping accuracy, and closing deals, this is your playground. What You Will Do- High-Volume Sourcing & Delivery: Own the end-to-end sourcing and pipeline management for mid-to-senior global roles. You will hunt via LinkedIn, regional job boards, GitHub, and cold-outreach to keep our pipelines buzzing. HQ & Candidate Facilitation: Screen global talent, pitch our vision, and seamlessly manage candidates through the interview process, acting as the primary point of contact. Data & Pipeline Transparency: Keep candidate trackers clean and updated, ensuring our global talent pipelines are accurate and moving fast. The DNA We Are Looking For- The Baseline (Hard Skills): Bilingual Mastery (English & Chinese): Both English and Mandarin Chinese must be your fluent working languages. You can interview global talent in flawless English and align instantly with our HQ hiring managers in Chinese. Proven Recruitment Engine: 2-4+ years of recruiting experience in tech, internet, or global expansion enterprises. A proven track record of delivering cross-border talent is a massive plus. Geographic Flexibility: Based in Indonesia, Vietnam, or the U.S., with deep roots in local talent networks but a completely global mindset. Core Traits (Soft Skills): The "Bias for Action" Delivery Machine: You are fiercely result-oriented, self-driven, and hyper-focused on closing roles. You think on your feet and get things done without waiting for instructions. Insatiable Curiosity & No Guardrails: You don't get trapped by fixed processes. You are eager to experiment with new sourcing hacks, leverage AI tools, and test bold outreach strategies to find that needle in a haystack. What You Will Get & The Challenges You Will Face What You Will Get: Uncapped Earning Potential: On top of your base rate, we offer a highly competitive, milestone-based placement bonus layout. The faster and more effectively you deliver, the more you earn. The Global Flex-Work Playbook: Get hands-on, practical experience inside a highly progressive global flexible-staffing ecosystem. You'll see exactly how a top-tier global tech brand runs an agile, remote talent network. A Trusted Extension of the Crew: No micromanagement. You enjoy the ultimate flexibility of a remote setup while having a world-class global TA team supporting you from behind. The Challenges You Will Face: 100% Remote Coordination: Working across time zones requires you to be hyper-proactive. You must be comfortable with asynchronous communication and managing your own energy and schedule. Embracing Ambiguity: Global talent markets move fast and change constantly. You need to be comfortable adjusting your sourcing strategy on the fly when a business need shifts. If you are a bilingual recruitment hustler who is ready to deliver global talent and write your own paycheck via performance bonuses, let's talk. Apply now and let's make a global impact together!

title: Project Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Project Manager em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Ten16 Creative is looking for a mid-level Project Manager based in Brazil to help keep our creative work clear, organized, and moving forward. Ten16 is a creative partner for technology-driven companies, helping teams turn complex products into clear, market-ready brand, campaign, design, web, video, and motion experiences. Our clients operate across areas such as AI, SaaS, gaming, entertainment, consumer electronics, connected hardware, and B2B technology. This is a remote contractor position for someone who is experienced enough to manage multiple moving pieces with confidence, but still hands-on, adaptable, and eager to grow with a fast-moving creative team. The right person will bring structure to creative work without slowing it down. They will help coordinate timelines, deliverables, client communication, internal reviews, production details, and day-to-day follow-through across projects that often involve strategy, design, writing, motion, video, web, and campaign development. About Ten16 Creative Ten16 Creative is a global creative studio with roots in the United States and São Paulo. We help tech-driven companies make complex products easier to understand, trust, and bring to market. Our work spans brand identity, campaign development, design systems, web design, presentations, marketing assets, video, motion, 3D animation, AI-powered production, and creative leadership. We work with companies that need a creative partner who can bring clarity, consistency, and structure to sophisticated products. Our clients have included technology, AI, SaaS, gaming, entertainment, and consumer electronics brands, with representative work across companies and projects in various tech-driven spaces. About the Role The Project Manager will be responsible for helping Ten16 plan, coordinate, and deliver creative projects from kickoff through final delivery. This person will work closely with creative directors, designers, producers, writers, motion teams, developers, and clients to make sure everyone understands what needs to happen, when it needs to happen, and what is required to deliver excellent work. This role is ideal for someone who has already worked in an agency, creative studio, production company, marketing team, or digital product environment and understands how creative work moves from brief to execution. The role does not require senior-level account leadership, but it does require organization, fluent English and Portuguese communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. You will manage active project timelines and ensure that milestones, deliverables, meetings, and reviews are clearly documented and communicated. You will help turn creative scopes into practical schedules, making sure that internal team members understand priorities and that clients understand what is needed from them to keep projects moving. You will coordinate daily and weekly project activity across brand, design, web, video, motion, campaign, and presentation work. This includes assigning or tracking tasks, following up on open items, preparing meeting agendas, documenting decisions, and making sure feedback is captured accurately. You will also help maintain project management tools, shared folders, project boards, calendars, and production documents so the team always has a reliable source of truth. You will support client-facing communication in English with professionalism and clarity. This may include sending status updates, recapping meetings, organizing feedback, preparing for presentations, and helping the team stay ahead of deadlines. Because Ten16 works with technology-driven companies, you should be comfortable working on projects where the subject matter may be complex, technical, or still evolving. You will help protect the quality of the work by making sure deliverables are complete, organized, properly labeled, and ready for review or delivery. You will not be expected to creative-direct the work, but you should have a strong eye for detail and enough creative production experience to recognize when something is missing, unclear, or not ready to send. Qualifications The ideal candidate has approximately 3–5 years of experience in project management, creative production, account coordination, marketing operations, agency operations, or a related role. They should have experience managing creative deliverables and coordinating cross-functional teams in a remote environment. They must be located in Brazil and must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. English fluency is essential because the role will involve written and spoken communication with U.S.-based team members and clients. Portuguese fluency is equally important for collaboration with Brazil-based team members and vendors.

title: Project Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Project Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Ten16 Creative is looking for a mid-level Project Manager based in Brazil to help keep our creative work clear, organized, and moving forward. Ten16 is a creative partner for technology-driven companies, helping teams turn complex products into clear, market-ready brand, campaign, design, web, video, and motion experiences. Our clients operate across areas such as AI, SaaS, gaming, entertainment, consumer electronics, connected hardware, and B2B technology. This is a remote contractor position for someone who is experienced enough to manage multiple moving pieces with confidence, but still hands-on, adaptable, and eager to grow with a fast-moving creative team. The right person will bring structure to creative work without slowing it down. They will help coordinate timelines, deliverables, client communication, internal reviews, production details, and day-to-day follow-through across projects that often involve strategy, design, writing, motion, video, web, and campaign development. About Ten16 Creative Ten16 Creative is a global creative studio with roots in the United States and São Paulo. We help tech-driven companies make complex products easier to understand, trust, and bring to market. Our work spans brand identity, campaign development, design systems, web design, presentations, marketing assets, video, motion, 3D animation, AI-powered production, and creative leadership. We work with companies that need a creative partner who can bring clarity, consistency, and structure to sophisticated products. Our clients have included technology, AI, SaaS, gaming, entertainment, and consumer electronics brands, with representative work across companies and projects in various tech-driven spaces. About the Role The Project Manager will be responsible for helping Ten16 plan, coordinate, and deliver creative projects from kickoff through final delivery. This person will work closely with creative directors, designers, producers, writers, motion teams, developers, and clients to make sure everyone understands what needs to happen, when it needs to happen, and what is required to deliver excellent work. This role is ideal for someone who has already worked in an agency, creative studio, production company, marketing team, or digital product environment and understands how creative work moves from brief to execution. The role does not require senior-level account leadership, but it does require organization, fluent English and Portuguese communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. You will manage active project timelines and ensure that milestones, deliverables, meetings, and reviews are clearly documented and communicated. You will help turn creative scopes into practical schedules, making sure that internal team members understand priorities and that clients understand what is needed from them to keep projects moving. You will coordinate daily and weekly project activity across brand, design, web, video, motion, campaign, and presentation work. This includes assigning or tracking tasks, following up on open items, preparing meeting agendas, documenting decisions, and making sure feedback is captured accurately. You will also help maintain project management tools, shared folders, project boards, calendars, and production documents so the team always has a reliable source of truth. You will support client-facing communication in English with professionalism and clarity. This may include sending status updates, recapping meetings, organizing feedback, preparing for presentations, and helping the team stay ahead of deadlines. Because Ten16 works with technology-driven companies, you should be comfortable working on projects where the subject matter may be complex, technical, or still evolving. You will help protect the quality of the work by making sure deliverables are complete, organized, properly labeled, and ready for review or delivery. You will not be expected to creative-direct the work, but you should have a strong eye for detail and enough creative production experience to recognize when something is missing, unclear, or not ready to send. Qualifications The ideal candidate has approximately 3–5 years of experience in project management, creative production, account coordination, marketing operations, agency operations, or a related role. They should have experience managing creative deliverables and coordinating cross-functional teams in a remote environment. They must be located in Brazil and must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. English fluency is essential because the role will involve written and spoken communication with U.S.-based team members and clients. Portuguese fluency is equally important for collaboration with Brazil-based team members and vendors.

Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Service Representative em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Instead of applying to one remote job, you could access a community where new remote opportunities become available every week. At Virtual Latinos, we connect experienced professionals from Latin America with growing companies in the U.S., Canada, and beyond that are building distributed remote teams. Our community includes more than 5,000+ professionals hired and 2,500+ companies that rely on Virtual Latinos to find skilled remote talent. Join a community where you'll learn, connect with like-minded professionals, and access real remote opportunities with top North American companies. Highlight Role of the Week! Customer Service Specialist (Remote) About the role: This opportunity is designed for experienced customer service professionals who are comfortable managing multi-channel support operations, resolving complex inquiries, handling escalations, and delivering high-quality customer experiences in fast-paced remote environments. Pay Rates: Part-Time Monthly Rates : $840-$$1,400 (based on 20 hours per week schedule) Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,680-$2,800 (based on 40 hours per week schedule) The posted monthly salary range is an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly, and pay is calculated based on the number of hours worked daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $10.50 - $17.50, depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable. Work Schedule: The work schedule will vary depending on the position and client. Most schedules align with U.S. and Canadian business hours. Key responsibilities: Multi-Channel Customer Support: Handle customer inquiries across phone, email, live chat, and social media, ensuring timely, professional, and solution-oriented responses. Escalation & Problem Resolution: Diagnose complex customer issues, troubleshoot effectively, and manage escalations through resolution while maintaining customer satisfaction and retention. Account Management & CRM Administration: Update and maintain accurate customer records, process account changes, and ensure data integrity within CRM and helpdesk systems (Zendesk, Freshdesk, HubSpot, Intercom, or similar). Product & Service Expertise: Maintain deep knowledge of products, services, and internal processes to provide accurate guidance and proactive recommendations to customers. Reporting & Process Improvement: Document customer interactions, identify recurring issues and trends, and provide actionable feedback to support teams and leadership to improve service quality. Depending on the client, you may also support order processing, returns management, knowledge base maintenance, or quality assurance initiatives. What you bring: Must be 21+ years old 1+ years of experience in customer service, customer support, or client-facing roles Bilingual English (C1 or above) / Spanish Required Skills: Strong understanding of customer service best practices, support workflows, and escalation procedures Experience working with CRM or helpdesk platforms (Zendesk, Freshdesk, HubSpot, Intercom, Salesforce Service Cloud, LiveAgent, Zoho Desk, or similar) Familiarity with communication and collaboration tools (Slack, Microsoft Teams, Dialpad, RingCentral, Aircall, or similar) Experience with ticketing and knowledge base systems (Jira Service Management, Help Scout, Confluence, Notion, or similar) Proficiency in productivity and scheduling tools (Google Workspace, Microsoft Office 365, Calendly, or similar) Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Spanish Ability to manage multiple conversations and priorities simultaneously in remote environments Strong organizational skills and meticulous attention to detail Empathetic, patient communication style with a focus on customer retention Comfortable handling confidential customer information with discretion How the process works: Apply through LinkedIn Easy Apply. Qualified candidates will receive instructions to complete their full application and join the Virtual Latinos community. Once accepted, you will gain access to ongoing remote job opportunities with U.S. companies looking for experienced remote professionals.

title: Database Reliability Engineer - Dbre
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Database Reliability Engineer - Dbre em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Somos a Vortigo - nascemos com o propósito de criar aplicativos mobile para um mundo em constante movimento, mas não paramos por aí. Ampliamos nossa atuação e hoje desenvolvemos softwares para ajudar empresas e startups no processo de transformação digital. Nosso time é composto por pessoas apaixonadas por desafios gigantes, mudando a experiência dos usuários a nível global. Estamos espalhados pelo Brasil e pelo mundo, tocando projetos nacionais e internacionais. Nosso ambiente é descontraído, com uma cultura horizontal, muita troca de conhecimento, reconhecimento e desafios! Tá afim de fazer parte de tudo isso? Dá uma olhada no que estamos buscando: Estamos em busca de um(a) DBRE (Database Reliability Engineer) para atuar em um ambiente orientado por Data Mesh, com foco em resiliência, automação e governança de dados distribuídos. Essa pessoa será responsável por garantir a confiabilidade, performance e escalabilidade dos bancos de dados utilizados pelas equipes de produto e engenharia. Responsabilidades: Projetar e implementar estratégias de confiabilidade para bancos de dados em domínios distribuídos. Automatizar processos de provisionamento, backup, monitoramento e recuperação de bancos de dados. Trabalhar em parceria com os times de produto e engenharia para garantir boas práticas de modelagem e performance. Atuar na observabilidade e rastreabilidade dos dados em ambientes SQL e NoSQL. Participar da definição de padrões e políticas de governança de dados dentro da arquitetura Data Mesh. Realizar troubleshooting e tuning de queries e estruturas de dados. Gerenciar e otimizar recursos de banco de dados em AWS, utilizando serviços como RDS, Aurora, EC2, S3, CloudWatch, IAM e Secrets Manager. Requisitos Técnicos: Experiência avançada com SQL Server, PostgreSQL e MongoDB. Domínio de AWS, especialmente em serviços voltados para bancos de dados e infraestrutura. Conhecimento em infraestrutura como código (IaC) com Terraform ou CloudFormation. Automação com PowerShell, Bash ou Python. Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (ex: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK). Familiaridade com arquitetura orientada a domínios (DDD) e Data Mesh. Conhecimento em CI/CD e integração com pipelines de dados. Experiência com ambientes cloud-native e containers (Docker, Kubernetes). O que você encontra aqui: Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar. Comunidades Técnicas – Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos. Cultura de Feedback – Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI). Horário Flexível - Autonomia para fazer a sua própria gestão da jornada de trabalho. Incentivo ao Idioma - Temos como objetivo internacionalizar cada vez mais a Vortigo e você será parte disso! Wellhub - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo. Reembolso de Equipamentos – Valor semestral de reembolso para compra de equipamentos que facilitam sua rotina de trabalho em casa.

title: Senior Solution Architect
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Solution Architect em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Role Our client helps organizations turn complex data into actionable intelligence. As a Senior Solution Architect, you will play a critical role in designing, implementing, and optimizing enterprise-grade analytics deployments for customers with complex technical and business needs. You will partner closely with customers, internal stakeholders, and product teams to ensure successful outcomes across architecture, deployment, scalability, and long-term value realization. Why Join the Solution Architect Team? Work at the intersection of customer success, cloud architecture, and data platforms. Help customers solve complex infrastructure, deployment, and performance challenges across our client's environments. Collaborate with Product, R&D, Support, and Customer Success teams to shape best practices and improve the platform. Influence architecture decisions for strategic customers and high-visibility engagements. In This Role, You Will Lead custom multi-node Linux installations and upgrades for our client's deployments, including troubleshooting complex deployment issues. Own and troubleshoot multi-node Windows-to-Linux migration projects, backup and restore processes, and architecture-related escalations. Analyze logs, system performance, and infrastructure telemetry to proactively identify risks and optimize customer environments. Partner with customer Application Developers, DevOps engineers, IT teams, and executive sponsors to drive successful outcomes. Act as the voice of the customer by sharing product feedback, submitting bugs and feature requests, and influencing roadmap priorities. Lead enablement initiatives for internal teams, mentor Solution Architects, and support technical interviews for new hires. What You've Accomplished So Far 5+ years of experience in customer-facing technical roles, including previous experience as a Solution Architect. Hands-on expertise with Linux (Ubuntu, Amazon Linux, RHEL/CentOS), Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, and cloud platforms such as AWS EKS and GKE. Strong experience troubleshooting distributed systems, networking, security, and monitoring tools such as Grafana and Coralogix. Advanced working knowledge of MongoDB or other NoSQL databases, including query optimization and troubleshooting. Intermediate SQL skills, with the ability to join data across disparate sources and optimize queries. Proficiency in scripting and programming using Bash, Python, JavaScript, and CSS. Experience with load-testing tools such as K6 and modern cloud data warehouse technologies (Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery) is a plus. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage both technical teams and executive stakeholders. How You'll Ramp Up By Day 30 Build a strong understanding of our client's architecture, deployment models, product capabilities, and customer engagement processes. By Day 60 Independently lead standard and custom deployment activities. Troubleshoot escalations and support customer architecture reviews. By Day 90 Own complex technical engagements end-to-end. Mentor junior team members.
